first_gate: Normal Debian base, X11, Enlightenment, Mesa/gears, SSH and VNC; optional applications follow that gate
ordering: required target base libraries using supported Debian bootstrap profiles for cycles
normal apt/dpkg target configuration and QEMU validation
native_tools: Use existing Debian amd64/all binaries; the broad native dependency cache does not expand target scope. A demonstrated native-helper defect may receive a small packaged source fix.
target_source_rule: Every queued source must supply a selected runtime package or a necessary target build dependency. Missing native tools do not authorize a new target language/toolchain port.
bootstrap_rule: Use profiles already supported by the source, record omitted outputs, and rebuild full packages when required by selected final binaries. Do not invent runtime paths, installation state or substitute a copied filesystem.

deferred_candidates.apache2: Not selected for the desktop image; appears through AppArmor Apache-module build requirements. Review the base library bootstrap before adding a target web server build.
deferred_candidates.apr: Apache-module chain; not an independently selected base desktop library.
deferred_candidates.gem2deb: Ruby packaging helper; review native role instead of automatically porting a Ruby toolchain.
deferred_candidates.ruby3.3: No selected desktop runtime requires Ruby at this stage; base C libraries use their supported bootstrap profiles when necessary.
deferred_candidates.sphinx: Native documentation helper is already provisioned; no further target documentation-tool port is selected.
deferred_candidates.gobject-introspection: Review native generator versus required target library role before scheduling this chain.
deferred_candidates.systemtap: Do not build a target tracing suite automatically; establish any required SDK/header-only output first.

not_selected: new Fortran/Go/Java compiler or runtime port
target web server stack for optional plugin outputs
full VM132 application inventory before the desktop works
